subject: science
passage: In many ant colonies, a large share of workers appear to do almost nothing, remaining motionless in the nest for long stretches. Entomologists once regarded these idle individuals as a puzzle, even a flaw in an otherwise efficient society. Experiments in which researchers removed the most active workers suggested a different reading: the formerly inactive ants soon took up much of the missing labor. Their idleness, then, may be less a sign of waste than a form of ______, a reserve that the colony can draw on when its workforce is suddenly depleted.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: The text says the idle ants may be "less a sign of waste" than something useful, and the phrase after the comma defines the blank: "a reserve that the colony can draw on" in an emergency. The word must mean protection against future loss.
explanation.A: Correct. Insurance is protection kept in reserve against a possible loss, which matches idle workers who step in when active ones disappear.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Defiance" means open refusal to obey, but the idle ants readily take up work when needed.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Nothing suggests the idle ants are tricking anyone; they are simply waiting in reserve.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Extravagance" means wasteful excess, which is the view the text says the experiments challenge.
